The lands which are subject to proposed LUB amendment are adjacent to 52nd Avenue North boundary and 51st Avenue Southern boundary. 51st Avenue is not constructed within the subject site. 52nd Avenue is a quarter used by residents entering and leaving town and may anchor the proposed residential developments in West Woodlands. The lands are flat and contain a treat area to the West. The lands are not affected by an abandoned wells. The lands do not appear to be affected by wetlands. Plan goals, expand and diversify the town's economic base while providing a high quality living environment for residents. Encourage growth on the town's economic development capacity by providing opportunities for commercial industrial development. The lands are identified as residential on map two future land use. Objective 5.2.1 of the MDP is to ensure that there's an adequate supply of competitively priced commercial land to realize Bruderheim's commercial development potential. Policies to achieve this objective call for council to encourage commercial development and promote the town of Bruderheim as a local commercial and service center for residents, visitors and industry. The proposed development creates opportunity for new commercial development and supports the policies in this objective. Objective 5.22 of the MDP is to distinguish between various commercial uses, including neighborhood commercial developments. Policy one defines neighborhood commercial developments as small retail outlets intended to provide goods and services to local residents. Policy two notes that the future of neighborhood commercial development may occur where specifically and dedicated in the town's land use bylaw within the areas designated residential on the future development plan. Object 5.2.3 of the MDP is to recognize emerging trends in retailing and commercial land use, including the creation of mixed use intensification nodes for future development areas. Policy one states that the mixed use developments that provide for commercial and residential uses within the same building will be encouraged. Policy two encourages that the town to identify important development sites and opportunities that have mixed use development potential and that would benefit the community.
